title: Scale
description: A declared ordered value space for scores and measures (CR-5 Phase 2; A004); e.g. a 0..1 ratio or a 1..5 ordinal range.

id.description: Stable OpenDEA identifier (CR-3Q). Type prefix: dea:scale-

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

scale_type.description: The scale type (CR-5 Phase 2; CR-MET-005 binding extension). Categorical and boolean added in CR-MET-005 per the user-supplied binding; ordinal/categorical/boolean scales must not be treated as physical measurement units.

scale_values.description: The allowed values for the scale (CR-MET-005). Required for scale_type: categorical, ordinal, and boolean (boolean MUST have exactly two entries). Optional for scale_type: nominal. For scale_type: interval and ratio, the numeric minimum/maximum apply.

ordered.description: Whether the scale is ordered (CR-MET-005). True for ordinal, interval, ratio; false for nominal, categorical, boolean (boolean is two-valued but not ordinal).

relationships.description: Derived convenience view (CR-1/CR-3): canonical relationship instances are authoritative.
